description: Angular component for managing and viewing billable hours, including loading data from API services, toggling UI states, and submitting new hours.

classes.name: HoursComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing and displaying billable hours, with functionalities for loading data, toggling forms, and submitting new entries.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component by loading data for hours, users, customers, and categories.

methods.name: loadHours
methods.description: Fetches the most recent billable hours from the backend and handles loading/error states.

methods.name: loadDropdownData
methods.description: Loads dropdown options for users, customers, and categories.

methods.name: toggleLogForm
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the form to log hours.

methods.name: logHour
methods.description: Submits a new billable hour record to the backend and updates the local list upon success.

methods.name: resetForm
methods.description: Resets the form data to default values.
